name: @thenetwork/plugin-network
description: The Network edge plugin for the Eliza shared agent: MEMBER_CONTEXT provider, SET_STATE action, NETWORK_SIGNALS evaluator, Network routing (state intent, structured action field, authz). Bound to an injected NetworkStore; Eliza Cloud supplies the Postgres store.

platformDetails.edge: createNetworkEdgePlugin factory with injected NetworkStore; no plugin-owned state
